{% include tag.html tag="added" %}

- **E-invoicing (XRechnung / ZUGFeRD)**
  * XRechnung export of outgoing invoices and ZUGFeRD PDF export with embedded XML.
  * E-invoice fields in a dialog with validation; PEPPOL validation warnings resolved.
  * Invoice attachments embedded in the e-invoice export; uploaded invoice PDF as alternative to the DOCX conversion.
  * E-invoice checker for displaying and validating ZUGFeRD/XRechnung files.
  * E-invoice fields moved from the customer to the account, plus contact person and bank account name.

++++

++++
- Autocompletion of the customer text in invoices and orders.
- Forecast template: status column; remaining budget distributed over the remaining months.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- NPE when cloning outgoing invoices.
- SEPA XML namespace handling with Spring Boot 3.4.

++++
